response.original_title: Billy Strings: Meet Me at the Crypt
response.overview: A professionally filmed full-length record of Billy Strings' Halloween concert at CFG Bank Arena in Baltimore, Maryland, on October 31, 2025. Billed as Meet Me At The Crypt, the classic Universal Monsters-themed presentation features Billy Strings and his band with Cory Henry, Alwyn Robinson, Vince Herman, Greg Garrison, Andy Thorn, Drew Emmitt, Jay Starling, the Charm City Coven and other guests across two sets and an encore.
response.title: Billy Strings: Meet Me at the Crypt
